book.name: Zenasis - Stat blo ebriting
book.title: Buk blo Zenasis stori baut stat blo ebriting

content: Lot ane pamle blo em ranwei kuikwan prom Sodom

Demtu einzel bin kesem de lo taun blo Sodom, ane i bin olredi naittaim. Lot, nepiu blo Eibram, i bin sidaun lo doawei blo da geit blo da taun. Ane wen Lot i bin luk demtu einzel, em bin stanap ane spik po demtu. ‘Wiswei?’ Den Lot bin nildaun prant wea demtu, pesdaun po graun.

Den Lot i spik, ‘Wiswei, ol pren blo mi? Kam gar, ane stap lo aus blo mi solong yutu ken wase leg blo yutu ane slip ya. Den moningtaim yutu ken go.’ Bat demtu ansa, ‘No, mitu go slip ya melen wea taun.’
Bat Lot i bin mina tokstrong, den demtu einzel i bin gri po go insaid aus blo em. Lot i bin meke mina big kaikai, ane em bin kuke bred nogad yis po demtu ane dempla bin lego po kaikai.
Bat bipo demtu einzel bin go po slip, ebri man lo Sodom, ol yangman ane ol oulman, stanap raun lo aus blo Lot.
Dempla ebriwan i ala po Lot, ‘Wea demtu man uda bin kam po stap lo yu ya tunait? Teke demtu kam po mipla solong mipla ken teke demtu po slip wea demtu.’
Lot i bin go ausaid po dem pipol ane sate doa biain lo em,
ane spik, ‘Pliz gar! Ol pren blo mi, no meke dem nadakain mina nugud samting.

Ai gad tu gel uda no bin slip lo man. Yupla mas laue mi po teke demtu kam po yupla solong yupla ken mekem wanem yupla wandem wea demtu. Bat no meke eniting nugud po demtu man ya uda stap wea aus blo mi, bikoz ai mas lugaut demtu.’

Bat dempla ala po Lot, ‘Gedaut prom rod blo mipla!’ Den dempla bin spik po wananada, ‘Ei! Dis man i ausaidman uda bin kam ya ane nau em wande akt wase em zaz blo mipla!’ Ane dempla bin spik, ‘Wa! So mipla nau go meke monugud samting po yu wiskain mipla go mekem po demtu.’ So dempla bin trai po grabe Lot po broke doa blo em daun.
Bat demtu man de insaid lo dat aus i bin pute an blo demtu go ausaid ane bin grabe Lot kam insaid da aus, ane demtu bin sate da doa biain lo em.
Ane demtu i bin meke ebridem ai blo dem man uda de wea da doa solong dempla kan luk da doa. So dempla bin gibap po trai po kam insaid.

Den demtu man i bin spik po Lot, ‘Yu gad ol nada pamle ya a? Teke ol tawi blo yu, ol boi ane ol gel blo yu, ane ol nada pipol uda i pamle blo yu ya wea da taun. Teke dempla ebriwan go ausaid prom dis taun.
Bikoz mitu go mina distroi dis ples. Da stingk blo dis taun i bin singaut kese da AntapGod ane da AntapGod bin sane mitu kam po distroi ebridem pipol blo dis taun.’

Lot i bin lego go po spik diskain po demtu man uda go kam man blo demtu gel blo em. Em spik po demtu, ‘Kuikwan, kamaut prom dis ples bikoz da AntapGod i ya kam po distroi dis ples.’ Bat demtu bin lap bikoz demtu bin tingk em meke pan po demtu.

Wen i bin stat po deilait, demtu einzel i bin trai po meke Lot po kuikwan kamaut. Demtu bin spik, ‘Teke oman blo yu ane tu gel blo yu ane kuikwan kamaut prom ya. Bambai yupla go wantaim lus wea ebridem nada pipol blo dis taun.’

Den Lot i bin wase apenap po go. So demtu einzel i bin kese an blo Lot ane pamle blo em bikoz da AntapGod i bin prapa soe gudpasin po Lot. Den demtu einzel i bin teke dempla gudwei go ausaid prom dat taun.

Wen demtu einzel i bin pinis teke Lot ane pamle blo em go ausaid prom dat taun, demtu einzel i bin spik po dempla, ‘Yupla mas kuikwan ranwei po seibe yuplaselp. No stap ane luk baigen. Wen yupla go, go ane no stap lo da platples blo Zodan Riba. Mata ran antil yupla kese dem il. Bambai yupla go ded.’
Den Lot i bege demtu einzel, ‘No gar, Lodbos.

Tru gar! Yutu bin trite mi prapa gudwei, seibe laip blo mi ane yutu bin soe gudpasinwei po mi. Bat ai kan kuikwan ranwei go po dem maunten bikoz ai prait. Bambai nada nugudting i go kese mi wea dem maunten ane ai go ded.
Yutu luk. I gad wan prapa smol biliz ya klostu so ai ken kuikwan ran go de. Pliz gar, ai ken ran go de solong da laip blo mi i gobi orait a?’
Wan dem einzel i bin ansa po em, ‘Orait. Ai go meke dis peiba po yu. Ai nogo distroi dat smol biliz.
Yupla kuikwan, ran go po dat biliz, bikoz ai kan meke eniting antil yupla go kesem de.’ Prom dat taim ol pipol i bin kole dat biliz Zoa, wea i min ‘smolples’.
Da san i bin stat po kamaut wen Lot i bin kesem de wea Zoa.
Den da AntapGod i bin stat meke ol ot ston wea i gad paia i ban, poldaun wase rein. Ol ot ston i poldaun antap lo demtu taun blo Sodom ane Gomora.
God i bin distroi demtu taun wea da bali blo Zodan Riba, kile ebridem pipol uda stap wea dem taun ane kile ebrisamting wea i gro lo da graun wea dem taun.
Bat da oman blo Lot uda bin wagbaut biain lo Lot, em bin luk gobaik po dat taun ane em bin tan kam po solt, ad wase ston.
Eibram i bin lego go prapa elimoning po da ples wea da AntapGod i bin stanap ane tok po Eibram.
So wen Eibram i bin luk godaun po Sodom ane Gomora ane da lan wea da bali blo Zodan Riba, em bin luk smok go antap prom dem taun wase wan nadakain bigpaia.
I bin demkain wen God i bin mina distroi dem taun blo da bali blo Zodan Riba. God bin mata tingbaut po Eibram wen em bin seibe Lot prom da taun bipo em bin distroi dem taun.
Demtu gel blo Lot i meke badting
Apta wen demting ya i bin apen, Lot bin lego go prom Zoa. Em bin stap wea dem maunten lo tu gel blo em. Em bin prait po stap wea Zoa, so em bin mata stap insaid keib wea tu gel blo em.
Wantaim, biggel blo Lot i bin spik po smolsisi blo em, ‘Papa blo yumi i oulman nau, ane i nogad no man ya raun po yumi go maret.
Kam, yumi go meke papa blo yumi dringk tumas wain po kam prapa spak, solong yumi ken slip wea em ane yumi ken meke pamlelain prom em.’

Dat seim nait, demtu i bin meke papa blo demtu dringk mina plenti wain. Da biggel blo Lot i bin go ane slip wea papa blo em. Bat Lot i no bin sabe wanem biggel blo em bin mekem bikoz em bin prapa spak.

Lo da neks moning, biggel blo Lot i spik po smolsisi blo em, ‘Wa tru! Lasnait ai bin slip wea papa blo mi. Kam, yumi go gibe em dringk gen tunait po mekem prapa spak gen, den yu ken slip wea em solong yumi ken meke pamlelain prom em tu.’
Wa! Dat seim naittaim, demtu gen bin meke papa blo demtu spak. Distaim smolsisi bin go ane slip wea papa blo em, ane Lot no bin sabe wanem smolgel blo em bin mekem bikoz em bin prapa spak.
So demtu gel blo Lot i bin kam pamle prom papa blo demtu.
Da biggel blo Lot i bin bone boi pikinini, kolem Moab.
Em bigate blo dem pipol blo Moab blo tidei.
Ane da smolgel blo Lot i bin bone boi pikinini kolem Benami.
Em bigate blo dem pipol blo Amon blo tidei.

footnotes.text: Moab wea langus blo dem Zuwispipol i seimkain wase dempla spik ‘blo mai Papa'.
Benami wea langus blo dem Zuwispipol i min ‘boi blo pipol blo mi’.
